name: On Reveal
text: Triggers once, when the card is revealed after being played.

name: Ongoing
text: A continuous effect that applies while the card is on the board.

name: Activate
text: An effect the player triggers once, on a later turn of their choosing, after the card is revealed.

name: End of Turn
text: Triggers at the end of each turn while the card is on the board.

name: Start of Turn
text: Triggers at the start of each turn while the card is on the board.

name: Game Start
text: Triggers at the start of the game, from the deck or hand.

name: When Destroyed
text: Triggers when the card is destroyed.

name: When Discarded
text: Triggers when the card is discarded from hand.

name: Objective
text: A goal written on the card with a progress counter; reaching it gives the reward that follows.

name: Moveable
text: The card can be moved once per turn by its player (a move ability on the card).

name: Quickdraw
text: An alternative, stronger effect written after the word, which applies under a condition the game sets (the condition is not in the source).

name: Empowered
text: Triggers when the card gains power while in hand, deck or play (as written on the card).

name: Horde
text: Adds power to a separate Zombie Horde of its player (a mode mechanic; its exact rules are not in the source).

name: Destroy
text: Removes a card from the board.

name: Discard
text: Removes a card from a hand.

name: Move
text: A card changes location after it is revealed.

name: Merge
text: Two cards become one, adding their power.

name: Afflict
text: Lowers the power of cards (as an ongoing or one-time debuff).
